pageSubtitle: Daily tasks, tips and warnings according to your role in HMS

hospital_admin.title: Hospital Administrator
dailyTasks: Review today's patient admission, outpatient and emergency statistics from the dashboard
Check today's duty roster and absences in the Staff module
Verify new patient registrations and appointment booking lists
Review today's financial transactions in Billing and Income-Expense module
Check today's schedule and bed occupancy in IPD and OT
Verify incomplete tasks and patient care notes from Nursing Station
Check system notifications and alerts and take necessary action
Check stock levels and low-stock alerts in Pharmacy and Inventory module
Complete new staff onboarding or permission updates in HR module
Review backup, logs and system health reports from Settings
weeklyTasks: Generate and review weekly income-expense and revenue reports
Share staff performance and attendance reports with department heads
Check lab and radiology module turnaround time and backlog
Verify biomedical waste and mortuary reports
Review departmental audit logs and user activity reports
Review and update system updates, roles and permission matrix
tips: View dashboard KPI cards every morning to set daily priorities
Assign role-based access correctly, do not give excessive permissions
Regularly review backups and audit logs for data security
Resolve billing discrepancies quickly for transparent financial transactions
Ensure real-time IPD bed management updates to reduce patient waiting time
Regularly monitor nursing station alerts and overdue task lists
commonMistakes: Giving super_admin permissions to staff who should not have them, risking data integrity
Not taking final approval after cancelling bills or giving discounts
Duplicate or incorrect IPD bed assignments
Applying changes directly to production without testing after Settings changes
Not reviewing audit logs regularly, making it difficult to detect unauthorized access
Ignoring pharmacy low-stock alerts, which can cause medicine shortages during emergencies

doctor.title: Doctor
dailyTasks: View today's OPD list and patient queue in Appointment module
Review patient previous history, tests and prescriptions from EMR
Write digital prescriptions in e-Prescribing module after OPD consultation
Order lab and radiology tests as needed
Review progress notes, vitals charts and medication charts for IPD admitted patients
Complete online consultations and follow-ups in Telemedicine module
Check OT schedule and pre-op checklist and approve
Update diagnosis, symptoms and treatment plan in patient medical records
Respond to care plans and nurse notes from Nursing Station
Refer patient to another specialist as needed in Referral module
weeklyTasks: Review progress report and discharge plan for each IPD patient during rounds
View own OPD and telemedicine consultation statistics report
Follow up and review pending lab and radiology result list
Check complete and incomplete documentation in medical records
Confirm OT and procedure schedule for next week
Verify patient follow-up and reminder settings
tips: Review history from EMR before each OPD patient for faster and accurate treatment
Write generic name and dosage clearly in e-Prescribing to reduce pharmacy errors
Correctly mark urgency level (Routine / Urgent / STAT) when ordering lab tests
Write daily IPD notes in chronological order for easy handover
Do not forget to auto-set patient follow-up date and reminder in Telemedicine
Enter diagnosis and ICD code correctly, important for insurance and reporting
commonMistakes: Writing incorrect dosage or frequency of medicine in e-Prescribing, causing dispensing errors at pharmacy
Writing prescription without checking patient allergy history in EMR
Not following up after ordering lab or radiology tests, leaving results pending
Not writing IPD progress notes regularly, causing confusion for other shifts
Approving OT without completing pre-op checklist
Not updating diagnosis or treatment plan in EMR, causing problems in subsequent consultations

nurse.title: Nurse
dailyTasks: View shift handover report at Nursing Station and read previous shift notes
Enter temperature, blood pressure, pulse, SPO2 and respiration for each patient in Vitals module
Verify patient bed status, admission and discharge list in IPD Management
Update medication administration records at scheduled times in Medication Administration module
Perform bed sore prevention, catheter care and infusion monitoring per Nursing Care Plan
Enter triage and initial vitals for newly arrived patients in Emergency module
Update monitoring charts and dressing records for OT and post-op patients
Regularly enter patient intake-output chart (IV fluid, oral, urine, drainage)
Check doctor's new orders and stat medicine alerts from Notifications and Alerts
Digitally collect informed consent forms from patients and guardians
weeklyTasks: Identify improvement or deterioration in patient condition from weekly vitals trend report
Review bed sore, fall risk and VTE prevention assessment report
Discuss medication errors and missed dose reports with department head
Check nursing station consumable stock (syringe, catheter, dressing) in Inventory module
Check own compliance and updates in Training and Certification module
Verify mortuary and MLC case documentation
tips: Double-check patient ID and bed number when entering vitals, avoid entering data for wrong patient
Follow 'five rights' (right patient, drug, dose, route, time) in Medication Administration
Correctly determine triage category (Red / Yellow / Green) in Emergency
Quickly update any change in patient condition via notification and doctor's orders
Write handover notes clearly and concisely for quick understanding by next shift
Do not forget to record patient/guardian consent when filling digital consent forms
commonMistakes: Entering vitals for wrong patient by not checking patient ID
Not marking as 'Given' in system after medication administration, causing dose duplication
Ignoring or responding late to doctor's new order notifications
Not entering intake-output chart on time, causing incorrect fluid balance
Assigning wrong triage category, causing emergency patient to receive delayed treatment
Not updating post-op monitoring chart regularly, delaying detection of complications

laboratory.title: Laboratory Staff
dailyTasks: Check today's pending test list and STAT orders in Lab module
Verify patient ID by scanning barcode during sample collection
Enter collection time, type and condition for each sample in Sample Tracking module
Schedule pathology, biochemistry, microbiology and hematology tests from Lab Catalog
Accurately input test results and verify reference ranges in Result Entry module
Update culture and sensitivity reports in Microbiology module
Update schedule and report status for X-ray, CT, MRI, USG in Radiology and Imaging module
Immediately send alert to concerned doctor and nursing station when critical value found
Update lab equipment calibration log and QC report in system
Review blood bag inventory, cross-match and issue records in Blood Bank module
weeklyTasks: Review weekly lab turnaround time (TAT) report and clear backlog
Analyze QC failure and repeat test causes, update calibration as needed
Check lab consumable and reagent inventory, create purchase requisition
Generate status report for pending and held samples
Verify blood stock and expiry report for Blood Bank
Update lab safety audit and biomedical waste disposal records
tips: Always scan barcode during sample collection; manual ID entry causes errors
In addition to system auto-alert, call the doctor by phone when critical value found
Review auto-validation report after result entry to avoid typographical errors
Use PACS integration for radiology reports, save images and text together
Digitally verify cross-match report in Blood Bank and ensure two staff signatures on issue record
Keep reagent expiry dates updated in system; expired reagents give incorrect results
commonMistakes: Not scanning barcode during sample collection and manually writing ID, causing misidentification
Delaying or not sending critical value alert, which can put patient life at risk
Writing incorrect decimal point or unit in result entry
Not maintaining proper storage conditions for pending samples, causing sample degradation
Not providing image reference in radiology report, causing issues in doctor's review
Running tests even after QC failure, causing incorrect results

reception.title: Receptionist
dailyTasks: Accurately enter new patient information (name, age, phone, address, NID) in Patient Registration module
Book and confirm walk-in and phone appointments in Appointment module
Issue tokens to correct department and doctor in OPD Queue Management
Collect OPD consultation fee, registration fee and other charges in Billing module and print receipt
Check bed availability for IPD admission and fill admission form
Enter preliminary information and triage category for Emergency patient and quickly send to Nursing Station
Search patient previous records by UHID and print history from EMR
Correctly process cash, card, mobile banking and insurance payments in Billing
Create advance payment and estimate receipt for OT and procedure bookings
Reconcile cash register and billing report at end of day and submit to supervisor
weeklyTasks: Generate weekly patient admission, OPD and revenue reports
Review appointment no-show and cancellation list and inform doctor
Check IPD bed occupancy and discharge planning report
Verify billing discrepancies and refund requests with supervisor
Review patient feedback forms and complaint log
Check front desk printer, barcode scanner and POS devices
tips: Accurately enter patient phone number and NID, important for SMS and follow-up
Search old patient by UHID to avoid duplicate registration
Double-check service name, quantity and price during billing
Never keep emergency patient waiting for billing, quickly send to Nursing Station
Correctly enter transaction ID in system after mobile banking payment
Do not forget end-of-day cash reconciliation to avoid financial discrepancies
commonMistakes: Entering incorrect patient name, age or phone number, causing issues in subsequent communication
Creating duplicate UHID by registering new patient without searching for existing record
Applying incorrect service charge or discount in billing
Holding emergency patient in billing process, delaying treatment
Selecting wrong payment mode (cash/card/mobile)
Not doing end-of-day cash reconciliation, causing accounting discrepancies

md.title: Managing Director
dailyTasks: Review hospital daily revenue, OPD, IPD and emergency statistics from Aggregate Dashboard
Check today's income, expense, cash flow and bank balance in Financial Dashboard
View staff attendance, absences and late arrival report in HR module
Verify patient satisfaction, infection rate and medication error metrics in Quality KPI module
Review important operational matters from Notifications and Escalation and provide direction
Assign tasks and follow up with department heads in system
Check critical stock and purchase orders in Supply Chain and Inventory module
Verify daily journal entries and ledger balance in Accounting module
View campaign performance and new patient acquisition in Promotion and Marketing module
Monitor regular activities and regulatory requirements in Log and Compliance module
weeklyTasks: Generate weekly Management Information System (MIS) report and present at board meeting
Analyze staff payroll, overtime and bonuses in HR and Payroll module
Review financial statements (P&L, balance sheet) and cost center analysis
Compare departmental budget vs actual expense and view variance report
Prepare stakeholder and investor reports
Approve capital expenditure (CAPEX) and new project proposals
tips: View KPI dashboard every morning for strategic decision making
Set custom alerts on dashboard to immediately know about budget overrun or infection spike
Assign specific KPIs and targets to department heads in system
Understand seasonal variability by viewing trend analysis of financial reports
Regularly monitor HR module turnover rate and recruitment pipeline
Keep regulatory compliance calendar and deadlines updated in system
commonMistakes: Only looking at revenue and ignoring costs and margins, making it difficult to understand profitability
Not reviewing HR attendance and payroll reports regularly, leading to overtime or fraud
Ignoring quality KPI alerts, putting patient safety and reputation at risk
Not viewing or taking action on budget variance reports
Delaying or providing incomplete data in stakeholder reports
Not reviewing compliance deadlines and audit logs, creating legal risk

director.title: Administration
dailyTasks: View high-level overview of hospital overall operations, revenue and expenses from Aggregate Dashboard
Review daily profit-loss (P&L) snapshot in Shareholder Reports module
Check today's cash inflow, outflow and bank position in Financial Dashboard
View daily operational reports and escalations from department heads
Verify waiting list for large financial transactions, purchase orders and contract approvals
View hospital asset management and capacity utilization reports
Create strategic updates and notes for stakeholders and board members
Review feasibility reports for adding new services, departments or technology
Analyze operational efficiency by comparing budget vs actual expense across departments
Monitor progress of compliance, license and regulatory requirements
weeklyTasks: Prepare Management Information System (MIS) report for weekly board meeting
Create weekly profit-loss, ROI and dividend analysis report for shareholders
Approve senior hiring or promotions after reviewing HR and Talent Management report
Review budget for large capital expenditure (CAPEX) and infrastructure projects
Review market competitive analysis and pricing strategy
Verify legal, audit and regulatory compliance status report
tips: Set custom executive summary on dashboard for at-a-glance view of important metrics
Understand seasonal patterns from P&L and balance sheet trend analysis and plan capacity
Verify system audit trail and documentation before major financial approvals
Set clear KPIs and dashboard access for department heads
Highlight cash flow and EBITDA alongside revenue in shareholder reports
Always include break-even analysis in feasibility reports for new projects
commonMistakes: Only looking at top-line revenue and ignoring bottom-line margin and cash flow
Approving large capital expenditure without detailed feasibility study
Making manual HR and senior hiring decisions without following system workflow
Not regularly reviewing budget variance and cost overrun reports
Not monitoring compliance and regulatory deadlines
Providing incomplete or erroneous data in shareholder reports, reducing credibility

pharmacist.title: Pharmacist
dailyTasks: Check today's prescription queue and STAT medicine requests in Pharmacy module
Receive digital prescriptions from e-Prescribing and verify dosage, frequency and drug interaction
Record batch number, expiry date and quantity for each medicine in Medicine Dispensing module
Check daily stock levels, low-stock and short expiry alerts in Pharmacy Inventory
Update narcotic and controlled medicine (SCHEDULE H) register and dispensing log
Prepare and deliver medicines per medication chart for IPD admitted patients and keep delivery record
Quickly complete urgent and special medication requests for OT and post-op patients
Follow up purchase orders and delivery with suppliers and drug manufacturers
Update medicine return and damaged stock records in system
Reconcile cash counter and dispensing report at end of day and submit
weeklyTasks: Review weekly stock movement, consumption and slow-moving item report
Check pharmacy medicine expiry list and clear short expiry items using FIFO method
Analyze supplier performance, delivery time and credit period
Perform physical stock verification and system reconciliation for narcotic and controlled medicines
Verify generic substitution and formulary compliance report
Audit pharmacy safety, storage conditions and biomedical waste disposal
tips: Always verify patient ID and prescription before dispensing medicine
Check drug interactions before dispensing, especially for patients on multiple medications
Use FIFO method for stock management to reduce expiry losses
Keep narcotic register updated with accurate dispensing records
Regularly communicate with suppliers about pending orders and delivery schedules
Perform daily cash and dispensing reconciliation to avoid discrepancies
commonMistakes: Dispensing medicine without checking prescription properly
Not checking drug interactions, potentially causing adverse reactions
Not following FIFO method, causing medicine expiry and financial loss
Not maintaining accurate narcotic register, risking regulatory non-compliance
Not following up purchase orders, causing stock shortages
Not performing end-of-day cash reconciliation, causing accounting errors
